paragraphs.text: 1. AGNI bestows the fleet prize-winning courser: Agni, the hero famed and firm in duty.
paragraphs.original: अग्निः सप्तिं वाजम्भरं ददात्यग्निर्वीरं श्रुत्यं कर्मनिष्ठाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: agniḥ saptiṃ vājambharaṃ dadātyagnirvīraṃ śrutyaṃ karmaniṣṭhām |

paragraphs.text: Agni pervades and decks the earth and heaven, and fills the fruitful dame who teems with heroes.
paragraphs.original: अग्नी रोदसी वि चरत्समञ्जन्नग्निर्नारीं वीरकुक्षिं पुरंधिम्
paragraphs.translit: agnī rodasī vi caratsamañjannagnirnārīṃ vīrakukṣiṃ puraṃdhim

paragraphs.text: 2. Blest be the wood that feeds the active Agni: within the two great worlds hath Agni entered.
paragraphs.original: अग्नेरप्नसः समिदस्तु भद्राग्निर्मही रोदसी आ विवेश ।
paragraphs.translit: agnerapnasaḥ samidastu bhadrāgnirmahī rodasī ā viveśa |

paragraphs.text: Agni impels a single man to battle, and with him rends in pieces many a foeman.
3. Agni rejoiced the car of him who praised him, and from the waters burnt away Jarutha.
Agni saved Atri in the fiery cave, and made Nrmedha rich with troops of children.
4. Agni hath granted wealth that decks the hero, and sent the sage who wins a thousand cattle.
paragraphs.original: अग्निर्दाद्द्रविणं वीरपेशा अग्निरृषिं यः सहस्रा सनोति ।
paragraphs.translit: agnirdāddraviṇaṃ vīrapeśā agnirṛṣiṃ yaḥ sahasrā sanoti |

paragraphs.text: Agni hath made oblations rise to heaven: to every place are Agni's laws extended.
5. With songs of praise the Rsis call on Agni; on Agni, heroes worsted in the foray.
paragraphs.original: अग्निमुक्थैरृषयो वि ह्वयन्तेऽग्निं नरो यामनि बाधितासः ।
paragraphs.translit: agnimukthairṛṣayo vi hvayante'gniṃ naro yāmani bādhitāsaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Birds flying in the region call on Agni around a thousand cattle Agni wanders.
paragraphs.original: अग्निं वयो अन्तरिक्षे पतन्तोऽग्निः सहस्रा परि याति गोनाम्
paragraphs.translit: agniṃ vayo antarikṣe patanto'gniḥ sahasrā pari yāti gonām

paragraphs.text: 6. Races of human birth pay Agni worship, men who have sprung from Nahus' line adore him.
paragraphs.original: अग्निं विश ईळते मानुषीर्या अग्निं मनुषो नहुषो वि जाताः ।
paragraphs.translit: agniṃ viśa īḷate mānuṣīryā agniṃ manuṣo nahuṣo vi jātāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Stablished in holy oil is Agni's pasture, on the Gandharva path of Law and Order.
7. The Rbhus fabricated prayer for Agni, and we with mighty hymns have called on Agni.
Agni, Most Youthful God, protect the singer: win us by worship, Agni, great possessions.
paragraphs.original: अग्ने प्राव जरितारं यविष्ठाग्ने महि द्रविणमा यजस्व
paragraphs.translit: agne prāva jaritāraṃ yaviṣṭhāgne mahi draviṇamā yajasva
